name: ui-ack
prompt: A short soft wooden toggle click, like a small brass latch snapping shut on a travel game box, dry and close.

name: dice-roll
prompt: Two small wooden dice rattling in a leather cup then tumbling across a wooden board, settling with light clicks.

name: checker-move
prompt: A single polished wooden checker sliding a short distance across a varnished wooden board and stopping with a soft tap.

name: checker-hit
prompt: A wooden checker striking another wooden checker with a sharp knock, the struck piece sliding off onto leather.

name: bear-off
prompt: A wooden checker lifted off a board and dropped into a small wooden tray, a gentle double knock.

name: rail-enter
prompt: A wooden checker taken from a leather rail and placed firmly onto a wooden point, one solid placement thud.

name: stakes-offer
prompt: A small brass doubling cube lifted and set down firmly on wood with a metallic-edged clunk, a deliberate offer.

name: stakes-accept
prompt: A brass cube picked up with a light metallic ring and pocketed, an agreeable bright chime-like acceptance.

name: stakes-decline
prompt: A brass cube pushed back across wood with a low dull scrape and a muted thud, a firm refusal.

name: invalid-move
prompt: A dull muted double knock of knuckles on wood, a low disapproving buzz-like thump, clearly negative.

name: no-moves
prompt: A soft resigned sigh of brushed leather and a single low wooden tap, conveying a skipped turn.

name: turn-change
prompt: A quiet wooden tick, like a small marker being flipped on a board, subtle and neutral.

name: game-win
prompt: A short celebratory fanfare of small brass bells and a wooden mallet roll, warm rising victorious flourish.

name: game-lose
prompt: A gentle descending phrase of muted wooden marimba notes with a soft leather thud, a calm good-natured defeat.

name: unlock-chime
prompt: Three bright ascending glass-and-brass chime notes with a light shimmer, announcing a newly unlocked reward.

name: ui-tick
prompt: A very short dry wooden click, like a clockwork pawn advancing one notch, faint and precise.
